_comment: Copy this to .vibeos-cli.local.json (gitignored) and edit. Deep-merged over the committed DEFAULTS in tests/qemu/cli/config.py. Only include keys you want to override. Example below switches the smoke/boot runner to the Windows-host QEMU backend (escapes WSL2 nested-virt contention; see docs/engineering/windows-host-qemu-spike.md). Leave backend at 'native' (the default) for real Linux or plain nested-WSL2 KVM.
